stories.title: Windhorst: Everything I know about why LeBron chos...
stories.summary: This decision creates massive questions for Philly, Cleveland, Miami and the legend who once again just rocked the NBA.

stories.title: LeBron chooses 76ers, calls it his 'last decision'...
stories.summary: LeBron James, after considering retirement, is continuing his NBA career with the 76ers. James is taking a two-year, $8 million deal, Klutch Sports Group CEO Rich Paul told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Wings' Fudd first rookie to win 3-point shootout
stories.summary: Wings guard Azzi Fudd edged the Fire's Bridget Carleton to become the first rookie to win the WNBA All-Star 3-point contest.

stories.title: Mahomes fully cleared for camp, feeling 'amazing'
stories.summary: Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes has been cleared to fully participate in training camp after knee surgery last year.

stories.title: Packers CEO questions team's financial viability
stories.summary: Packers president and CEO Ed Policy says adjustments might be necessary as the NFL's only publicly owned franchise attempts to remain financially competitive in the long term.
